The '''Vanguard probot''' was a [[Class two droid/Legends|second-degree]] [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] designed and manufactured by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] during the final [[Standard year/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was made to assist deep-[[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] and [[Scout/Legends|explorers]] in mapping out new [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|routes]]. The use of Vanguard droids ensured that the [[Sentience/Legends|organic]] scouting crew did not have to perform jumps into unknown territory.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Droids" />
